description: The Ossuary is a tree of squares per class (S-22-01): one column per spell of data/spells.json, one square per level from 2 to levels.max, each needing the one below it. The tree is built from the two files, so this one holds only the prices and the demo cut.

demoMaxLevel.description: The demo sells the squares up to this spell level (GDD 19.2).

levelCosts.description: Souls for the square of level 2, 3, ... levels.max of a spell; strictly increasing.
